summary.text: Andrae Gonzales is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a member of the Bakersfield City Council, representing Ward 2 since December 2016, and previously served on the Bakersfield City School District Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Gonzales was born in Bakersfield, California, graduated from East Bakersfield High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Berkeley in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive director.
Gonzales served on the Bakersfield City School District Board of Education, Trustee Area 4, from 2010 to 2016.

He took office on the Bakersfield City Council on December 14, 2016, was re-elected in 2020, and won re-election in the November 5, 2024 general election, defeating Michael Cardenas; his current term ends in 2028.
